lines: Under Profile, Custom workout sets up your own ride. Telo Ride drives the bike's resistance; you pick how.
It starts from GCN's thirty-minute HIIT: eight thirty-second efforts, the recoveries shrinking from three minutes to ninety seconds. Four other plans sit beside it.
Each round steps on its own: efforts by five seconds, recoveries by fifteen. Add a round, remove one, or make every round the same. The plan then reads edited.
Work and recover resistance slide from one to thirty-two. Warm-up and cool-down step a minute at a time.
Flat resistance holds one level the whole ride: pick it, how long, and a cadence goal. You set the pace with your legs.
Custom workout, from a phone to the full screen.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
